alt: Two-item checklist of what would change the map-size page: a published measurement, or a figure posted by Rockstar.

data.title: What would give us a real number

cards.title: A published measurement
cards.body: Someone measures the playable area and publishes the method. We will show the method and the date.

cards.title: A figure from Rockstar
cards.body: If Rockstar posts a km or mile figure, we will switch the table to that number.

data.note: Until then, the only official claims are the two ratios on this page.
